title: Unified canonical audio and audiovisual handoff result v6
$comment: New internal results use v6 and handoff v2. Audio-only results have visual.status=NOT_PROVIDED and null video/evidence digests; no video evidence is fabricated. audioResult/audioAssociation/audioVisual are internal audio verification structures, not alternate wire versions. Original bytes, frozen prepare, identity and same-source bindings remain mandatory. This source contract does not assert operational activation.

inputValidation.description: Development-only sidecar; never part of ai_core_result_v1.
inputValidation.title: InputValidationResultV1

coaching.$comment: Closed service wrapper transcribed from pinned adapter.py dispatch. No frozen result schema exists. Error/fallback fields are Python exception class names only.

rubricResult.$comment: Opaque AI-owned official worksheet result. No Backend rubric revision, phoneme order, level, or arithmetic validation.

scoringRecord.$comment: Opaque historical AI worksheet metadata. The Backend does not recalculate or validate official phone worksheets.

computedScore.$comment: AI-owned calculated overallScore. Legacy rubric metadata is optional and opaque to consumers; no peer worksheet/version/phone-level gate.
